title: Clothing Chest
summary: Open this epilogue chest for dyes and generic camp outfits.

fields.Contents: 10 of every dye, 20 Dye Removers, and one of each generic piece of camp clothing, footwear and underwear.
fields.Durability: Medium Toughness. A single hit must deal at least 22 damage to damage the chest.

changes: Used the pinned wiki title to distinguish this unique epilogue container from its generic in-game display name. Added location, contents, and toughness.
